time_selection.exhaustion: fail complete context/collection; preserve all costs, partial custody and original cohort; never drop starts/electrodes/conditions

retention_derivation: All85 raw submissions (1360MiB), all85 admitted canonical outputs (1360MiB), all27 operator audits (108MiB), all3 assembled corrected/operator panels (48MiB), largest complete spectral view below1GiB plus author source/contracts, all6programs at48MiB,85journals at85MiB, full sources/metadata and conservative allocation overhead remain below6GiB. Views retire only after exact natural native closure. No raw output retirement or compression credit is assumed.
cumulative_IO_derivation: Streaming spectral inputs are copied and verified four times per arm; Stage2 full signed apertures are exact-deduplicated per view but never reduced. Source-bound CLI reservation is charged before each phase; raw/admitted/panel writes and perphase tmpfs output reservations are separate. All attempt charges survive failure. Read/write caps are logical selected-artifact envelopes, not measured full-OS traffic.

portable_compute.cache_key: exact aperture identity plus currentrole; never cross-context response state
portable_compute.fixed_input_factorization: 16kernel columns at a time; one3969projection grid per distinct exact aperture in each context, reused across electrodes/signals
portable_compute.remaining_cost: dynamic training-dependent forward trials still use exact scalar vendor forward, including full-aperture validation; further caching requires source review, not silent reduction in grid/starts

excluded_from_numeric_claims: host swap and Docker backing-store growth
protected_grading: Collection never runs grading. Full private per-case report can exceed producer-artifact limits; a separate reviewed scoring operation must bind its input/output/cumulative budget before any private call.
